response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced full-stack engineer (15+ years) with strong systems knowledge, but his profile is centered on TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and web platforms rather than modern C++. His only substantial C++ experience was a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015, and there is no evidence of IEC 62443 / SDL exposure, MQTT, industrial protocols, or industrial automation domain experience — all core to this role. Despite relevant adjacent skills (low-latency systems, event-driven architecture, mentoring), the gap on the primary hard requirement (deep, current C++/STL expertise and industrial cybersecurity) is too large.
strengths: Deep systems-programming background: low-latency, async I/O, high-throughput microservices (millions of req/sec) at Dunnhumby
Event-driven architecture experience and strong testing/craftsmanship culture (TDD, CI/CD, test frameworks authored)
Proven mentor and knowledge-sharer via workshops, courses, and conference talks
concerns: Minimal and outdated professional C++ experience (brief role ending in 2015); primary languages are TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang
No industrial automation, IEC 62443/SDL, or protocol experience (MQTT, OPC UA, Modbus, IEC 61850)
Career trajectory oriented toward web/cloud product engineering, misaligned with an on-prem industrial C++ role

key_factors.factor: No industrial cybersecurity or IEC 62443 background
Strong distributed-systems and low-latency engineering experience
